answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the yarrow queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1736 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ocean. The nadir index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Verification alone takes 11 days each. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
